The Mayfair Kids Bed is a handmade upholstered children's bed with a classic buttoned panel headboard. The softly padded headboard sits on a solid low frame, made to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire, from £311.99 in Kids Single 2.6ft to £376.99 in Small Double 4ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Classic buttoned panel headboard design
  • Low frame with solid construction
  • Soft, durable upholstered fabric
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes

  • Kids Single 2.6ft: £311.99
  • Single 3ft: £337.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £376.99

Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress. Our 1000 Pocket Sprung Mattress and other mattresses come in the same sizes.

Customisation

Pick solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Compare the Chester Kids Bed, browse all kids beds, or read our kids upholstered beds guide.

FAQ

What sizes does the Mayfair Kids Bed come in?

Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft.

What does the headboard look like?

It is a classic buttoned panel headboard, softly padded and upholstered by hand.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check the colour and feel at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Mayfair Middle Line Bed is an upholstered bed frame whose headboard carries a single bold horizontal middle line, the signature of the Mayfair design. It is deeply padded and handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Mayfair middle line panel headboard design
  • Deeply padded premium upholstered headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £324.99; Small Double (4FT) £350.99; Double (4FT6) £376.99; King (5FT) £402.99; Super King (6FT) £454.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What does the middle line look like?

A single horizontal line runs across the middle of the padded headboard, keeping the design simple.

Where can I see other Mayfair beds?

Try the Mayfair Upholstered bed, or browse all our upholstered beds.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Need storage and a headboard in one purchase? The Mayfair Ottoman Divan Bed combines the Mayfair upholstered headboard with an end-opening hydraulic gas lift ottoman base, so the whole space under the mattress becomes storage. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £337.99 in Single 3ft to £519.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Mayfair upholstered headboard
  • End-opening hydraulic gas lift ottoman base
  • Large underbed storage compartment
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

  • Single (3FT): £337.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £415.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £441.99
  • King (5FT): £467.99
  • Super King (6FT): £519.99

Not sure which size you need? See our UK bed sizes guide.

Storage

The base lifts on hydraulic gas struts at the foot end, opening the storage underneath while the mattress stays in place. Leave clear floor at the foot of the bed and check there is nothing fixed above that would stop the platform opening. See how ottoman beds work.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, with custom fabric and colour options available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Compare the Bumper Ottoman Storage Bed or browse divan ottoman beds. Not sure of the difference? Read ottoman bed vs divan bed.

FAQ

How does the gas lift storage work?

Hydraulic gas struts raise the mattress platform from the foot end, opening the storage underneath.

Is the headboard included?

Yes, the Mayfair upholstered headboard is part of the design.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check colour and texture at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
